title: SetupProjection
description: Where a harness host declares its model and reasoning-effort setup surface and which skill owns the host-specific steps. A declaration of surface, never a capability or runtime claim.

source.description: host-cli: the host CLI enumerates models and effort and a host-home config is written. host-catalog: role-to-model bindings ship in a repo-projected catalog. inherit: children inherit the parent session model. none: no model or effort setup surface.

skill.description: Skill name under skills/ that owns this host's setup steps. Only host-cli declares one.

catalog.description: File the host reads role-to-model bindings from. A ~ path is a host-home write target; a repo-relative path must exist.

overlay.description: Per-role overlay directory the setup writes, or null when the host has no per-role overlay.

effort.description: live-enum: probe the host CLI for its usable levels. inherit-parent: no per-role level. none: the host exposes no per-role effort.
